vulnerable_results.title: IAM policy grants wildcard administrative privileges (Action:* / Resource:*)
vulnerable_results.blast_radius: Full account compromise: any compromised workload assuming app-automation-role can create admin users, exfiltrate all S3 buckets, or terminate production infrastructure.
vulnerable_results.remediation: Scope IAM Action list to s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, s3:ListBucket on the specific S3 bucket ARN and enforce aws:SecureTransport.

vulnerable_results.title: S3 bucket allows public access (acl=public-read or PublicAccessBlock disabled)
vulnerable_results.blast_radius: Unauthenticated internet users can list and download customer PII exports from acme-customer-pii-exports-prod.
vulnerable_results.remediation: Set acl = private and enable all four aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block flags (block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, restrict_public_buckets).

vulnerable_results.title: S3 bucket lacks AWS KMS Server-Side Encryption configuration
vulnerable_results.blast_radius: Data at rest in S3 is not protected by customer-managed KMS keys and lacks key-level audit trails.

vulnerable_results.title: EBS volume is unencrypted at rest (encrypted = false)
vulnerable_results.blast_radius: Database volume snapshots or physical media exposure reveal plaintext customer records.
vulnerable_results.remediation: Set encrypted = true and attach a customer-managed kms_key_id on aws_ebs_volume.

vulnerable_results.title: Security Group exposes SSH (22) or RDP (3389) to 0.0.0.0/0
vulnerable_results.blast_radius: Direct internet exposure enables automated credential stuffing, SSH/RDP brute force, and remote code execution attempts against management ports.
vulnerable_results.remediation: Remove 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on ports 22/3389; restrict SSH to corporate VPN bastion CIDR (10.24.0.0/24).

vulnerable_results.title: CloudTrail is not multi-region or lacks log file integrity validation
vulnerable_results.blast_radius: Attackers operating in non-default AWS regions evade audit logging, or can tamper with delivered CloudTrail log files undetected.
vulnerable_results.remediation: Set is_multi_region_trail = true, enable_log_file_validation = true, and configure kms_key_id.
